observed_behavior: Database progress starts after file writes and cleanup, or stays at 0% during a slow freshness scan after fast record loops.
expected_behavior: Report ongoing reconciliation and flush processed counts before a slow following operation, without reporting publication success before commit.
causal_mechanism: The progress lifecycle excluded file reconciliation and deletion. Its time throttle then suppressed all fast record updates before a synchronous freshness scan whose source collector did not receive the progress callback. The initial repair also omitted nested certificate input verification during manifest discovery, which reproduced a 37,324 ms callback gap on the actual Gwen obligation document.

anti_pattern.structural_description: Progress callbacks cover only the final subset of a transaction and rely on future callbacks to flush throttled state across a blocking operation.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: Slow omitted work is invisible, and a slow following operation prevents any newer callback from displaying work already completed.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Progress starts before reconciled database work, counts completed work, and flushes before entering the freshness scan; completion requires commit.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Count files and removed records alongside entity/search records, force a boundary update before freshness validation, and forward source-progress callbacks through freshness collection. Flush the manifest boundary before obligation verification and expose completed certificate input-set, artifact and file checks as nested progress.

applicability_conditions: Incremental reconciliation includes file writes or stale row deletion.
Record loops finish within the renderer throttle interval before an expensive freshness scan.
known_non_matches: A genuinely sub-second phase that completes immediately has no prolonged hidden work.
confirmation_evidence: Slow-client tests failed before the first file write in both TTY and redirected output.
Fixed-clock tests found only 0% at freshness entry despite completed record loops.
Focused regressions passed after correction, including no success after freshness failure.
Read-only Gwen source collection reproduced 0/398 for 37,324 ms before manifest 362; the obligation document contains 294 certificates.
Corrected read-only Gwen collection emitted 871 input callbacks and reduced the maximum callback gap to 1,057 ms, with advancing displayed input counts.
